name: Pipeline Repair
description: Bounded pipeline repair using durable tasks, evidence, waits, and effects.

stages.title: Capture incident and diagnose: {goal}
stages.description: Capture incident state and diagnose {goal}. Separate symptoms, root cause, mitigation, and repair. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Incident timeline and failing boundary are supported by observations

stages.title: Perform bounded repair: {goal}
stages.description: Before risky actions create a durable confirmation blocker. Use effect prepare/start and reconcile receipts. Represent pipeline observation as a durable external wait. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Repair or mitigation has current authority, effect receipts, and rollback instructions

stages.title: Observe healthy operation: {goal}
stages.description: After the external wait, independently observe healthy runs and run `{test_command}`. Distinguish restored, mitigated, and still blocked outcomes. Use a task workspace before edits. Set an evidence contract for the exact delivered revision and environment. Record criterion evidence; test with `{test_command}`. Raise durable findings or confirmation blockers when scope or authority is unclear.
acceptance: Healthy runs and backlog disposition are verified on the resulting configuration

stages.title: Explain incident and result: {goal}
stages.description: Use why and export to produce a factual postmortem for {goal}. Label hypotheses and unresolved causes.
acceptance: Postmortem cites the timeline, attempts, effects, verification, and remaining work
